{{Quote|An entire nest of Gand who have come, all of them having left their colony, but they will not say why they come here to hunt.|translated=1|[[Vossk]]|<ref name="kotor2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
A '''nest''' referred to a group of [[Gand/Legends|Gands]] that hailed from the same [[Gand (planet)/Legends|Gand]] [[Pocket colony|colony]]. Whether or not these Gands were related was unclear.

A nest of Gands relocated to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="kotor2" /> in [[3951 BBY]]<ref name="kotorcg">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> in order to collect the bounty on a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] set by the local [[Exchange]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[G0-T0]].<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gand Nest was introduced in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[Obsidian Entertainment]] in late [[2004]]. The nest is mentioned by [[Vossk]] to the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] as description of group of Gands that are hunting her.
